China Conducts Submarine-Launched Missile Test, Causing Regional Concern

China's People's Liberation Army (PLA) has reportedly conducted a test of a submarine-launched intercontinental ballistic missile, identified by some as the JL-3. The test has generated concern among defense experts in the United States and has been described as an act of "bullying" by some Indian media. The missile's capabilities and potential implications for regional stability are a focus of discussion.
